inspiration.observed_pattern: A MariaDB comparison expression normalizes JSON documents and their nested values before comparison.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one independently authored JSON column, one nested JSON_EXTRACT path, and one JSON_NORMALIZE projection; unrelated document rows and outer report columns are removed while nested extraction and result metadata remain observable.

fixture_notes: The fixed document contains an array of two objects; normalizing the extracted array must preserve its canonical JSON text and LONG_BLOB metadata.
determinism_notes: One fixed primary-key row and one ordered read are used; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are involved.
setup: CREATE TABLE nested_normalize_probe (probe_id INT PRIMARY KEY, document_value JSON NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT probe_id, JSON_NORMALIZE(JSON_EXTRACT(document_value, '$.items')) AS normalized_items FROM nested_normalize_probe ORDER BY probe_id
